summary: Spectral builds an enterprise IDE + copilots for engineering teams. Evaluation for a two-week POC focused on nightly embeddings refresh and low-latency in-editor completions. Interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput and Optimize for batching/caching recommendations.
notes: Background: product = cloud IDE + hosted copilots for mid-enterprise dev teams. Many customers require on-prem or VPC options for source code privacy.

Primary technical problem: large mono-repos (20M+ LOC across services). Need nightly embedding refresh + incremental indexing with a <1 hour maintenance window. Current pipeline (in-house) stalls under peak parallelism.
Performance targets: in-editor streaming completions <100ms tail for single-token streaming; background embedding pipeline throughput ~50k documents/hour with KV/prefix reuse.

Cost sensitivity: engineering org is cost-aware; want to separate interactive (low-latency) vs background (batch, cost-optimized) routing. Mentioned need for model pinning + automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variants for batch jobs.
Security asks: SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs retained 1yr, KMS integration. EU customers want data residency options (possible Private deployment later).
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-10): 'We need background jobs that don't steal all GPUs from interactive completions. If we can pin models and route nightly jobs to cheaper capacity, that's huge.'

Asked about: continuous batching, prefix/KV cache reuse across incremental index runs, and runtime support for mixed-precision/quantized variants. Wants sample kernel/latency profiles for CodeGen-style models.
Interested in Redwood Optimize: wanted automated batching suggestions and specific quantization recommendations per workload (embeddings vs completion).

Decision criteria: stable 99th percentile latency for editor completions, predictable nightly reindex window, and cost per 1M tokens below internal threshold. Legal + Security sign-off required for any VPC/Private deal.
Shortcomings of current vendors: Sourcegraph's embeddings pipeline is ok but expensive at scale; GitHub Copilot doesn't support enterprise embedding refresh or private VPC hosting of model runtime.
Internal champions: Head of Platform (Eva Martinez) and ML Lead (Ravi Desai). Eva pushed for Redwood after latency demo; Ravi is evaluating model quantization tradeoffs.

POC ask: 2-week Dedicated pool with 4x A100-equivalent slots for parallel embedding refresh + sample streaming completion SLA. Include runbook for autoscaling and fallback to hosted if capacity spikes.
Stubs/Links: pricing deck shared (drive link), security FAQ sent, Fireflies call transcripts attached. SE (Ethan) to provide model version compatibility matrix and sample billing estimates.
Next steps (short): schedule infra sizing call w/ infra team (week of 2026-03-15), deliver POC SOW, provide estimated token/month cost scenarios for mixed interactive + batch workloads.
